title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Developer
Job Location: Dubai
We are seeking a senior full stack developer to build secure, accessible digital services. The role centers on React and single-page applications, with full stack delivery and working familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM).

Key responsibilities
* Build and maintain responsive React applications using TypeScript or JavaScript, reusable components, and well-structured frontend code.
* Develop well-designed APIs and backend services that support reliable, secure digital experiences.
* Integrate applications with Microsoft Dynamics CRM and other services using appropriate APIs and authentication patterns.
* Turn requirements into technical designs, estimate work, and deliver maintainable features with clear documentation.
* Apply accessibility, performance, security, testing, code review, and monitoring practices throughout delivery.
* Guide technical decisions and mentor developers while collaborating with product, design, and CRM teams.

Required experience
* Strong experience delivering production web applications with React, TypeScript or JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and single-page application patterns.
* Hands-on backend development and API design experience, including REST, data access, integration, and automated testing.
* Familiarity with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement or Dynamics CRM, Dataverse concepts, and CRM API integration.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development using coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools, including reviewing and validating generated code.
* Experience with secure development, source control, CI/CD, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Ability to own complex work, explain technical trade-offs, and collaborate effectively across disciplines.
Additional experience
Experience with .NET and C#, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, design systems, or accessibility standards is an advantage.
